name: Attikan Shade Barrel Fermented Washed
description: One of our favourite estates to work with, Attikan brings us another standout lot this season. Nestled in the Biligiriranga Hills of Karnataka and run by the Sangameshwar Group, Attikan has long been a source of expressive, high-quality coffees that we’re always excited to roast. This year’s release is a 22-hour shade barrel fermented washed coffee, roasted by Rossette as a medium roast to bring out both complexity and balance. In the cup, expect layered notes of plum, black grapes, prune, molasses, and milk chocolate. It’s a beautifully structured single-origin Arabica that shines equally well as a black coffee and with milk, where its sweetness and milk chocolate character come forward even more clearly. With medium acidity and a rich, smooth profile, this is a coffee that feels both elegant and comforting. Whether you brew it as espresso, moka pot, AeroPress, or cold brew, Attikan is a must-try for anyone who loves sweet, fruit-forward coffees with depth and character.

name: Harley Whiskey Barrel Aged (SCA 87+)
description: Grown at elevation of 1050 MASL in the Sakleshpur region of Karnataka, these washed coffee’s from Harley Estate undergo a barrel ageing process in single malt whiskey barrels sourced from Amrut Distillers. This produces a cup which is fruity, boozy and sweet with notes of irish cream, green apple, stone fruit and hints of spice. The coffee is roasted to a medium level to increase the sweetness and balance the body & mallic acidity of the coffee. This coffee is suitable for espresso, pourover, aeropress and French press.

name: 4th Birthday Blend
description: Rossette 4th Birthday Blend Celebrate 4 years with a cup that tastes like party: a warm, indulgent blend made from two microlots from Ratnagiri Estate,that opens with tiramisu-soaked cocoa and rounded hazelnut, drifts into soft vanilla sweetness, and finishes with a playful rum-ball warmth. Medium roasted to highlight clarity across brewing styles, this balanced blend brings medium sweetness, medium acidity, and medium body—designed to shine from espresso to pour-over, AeroPress to drip. It’s our cake in a cup: familiar, celebratory, and crafted for every ritual that made Rossette what it is today.

name: Ratnagiri Jasmine Co-Fermented Naturals (SCA 88+)
description: This limited-release Ratnagiri Jasmine Co fermented naturals is a floral-focused co-ferment our fourth from Ratnagiri but intentionally separate from the fruit co-ferment series, roasted light for black-coffee lovers who’ve yet to try floral coffees: it opens with an expressive bouquet of jasmine and magnolia, unfolds into dessert-like sweetness of vanilla bean and custard apple, and finishes bright and clean with a lemon candy lift; very high on sweetness with medium acidity and a very low body, it shines when brewed as a pourover, AeroPress, cold brew, or americano, Brewed right will reward you with its delicate clarity.

name: Ratnagiri Strawberry Co-Fermented Naturals (SCA 88+)
description: Strawberry Co-Ferment is the third release in our Fruit Ferment Series and our highest-scoring coffee yet, rated 88+ on the SCA scale. Processed at Ratnagiri Estate as a yeast-inoculated natural co-fermented with strawberry, this light roast is built to capture the taste of summer in a cup. Expect vibrant notes of strawberry, cotton candy, bubblegum, and cherry blossom, with a profile that evokes strawberry iced tea juicy, playful, and unmistakably funky. Best suited for drinkers who enjoy bold fruity character over clean, traditional cups. Best consumed black.

name: Ratnagiri Watermelon Co-Fermented Naturals (SCA 87+)
description: Ratnagiri Watermelon Co-Ferment is a light roast from our new Fruit Co-Ferment Series, crafted to taste like summer in every cup. Processed at Ratnagiri Estate in Chikmagalur, South India by producer Mr. Ashok Patre, this coffee is bold, tropical, and intensely expressive. Expect watermelon, bubblegum, Jolly Rancher candy, purple grapes, and raspberries with high sweetness and bright acidity. Best enjoyed black, hot or iced. This is not a coffee for those seeking a clean cup ,it’s for drinkers who want extra funk, character, and a truly unforgettable profile.

name: Gungegiri Dark Honey
description: We are thrilled to introduce the highly anticipated Gungegiri Dark Honey Coffee , a single-origin specialty from the renowned Gungegiri Estate in Chikmaglur, India. Grown at an elevation of 4,600 feet. Dark Honey processing leaves a generous amount of sticky, fruit-rich mucilage on the coffee bean during drying. This slow, shade-dried approach allows natural fruit sugars to deeply ferment and absorb into the seed, resulting in an exceptionally full-bodied cup with a heavy, viscous mouthfeel. The coffee is a symphony of flavour that draws you in with its rich, dessert-like profile, reminiscent of a warm slice of banana bread enfolded with the sweetness of jaggery. The coffee's vibrant essence  of clementine and a subtle whisper of kiwi like finish

name: Yelnoorkhan Yeast Anaerobic Honey (SCA 85+)
description: Yelnoorkhan Anaerobic Honey coffee is produced using a method that combines anaerobic fermentation with honey processing. In this process, the coffee cherries are fermented in an oxygen-free environment, which enhances their fruity acidity and aromatic complexity. Following this, the beans are pulped and dried with some of the sticky mucilage (the 'honey') still attached, further enriching the coffee's sweetness and body. The resulting brew is lauded for its vibrant, grapes-like brightness, layered fruit notes, and a rich, raisin-like sweetness. These characteristics create a smooth and rounded mouthfeel, highlighting both the precision of controlled fermentation and the inherent qualities of the coffee's origin. This coffee is roasted to a medium-light level which allows us to brew it for both manual brews and complex espressos.

name: Robusta Kaapi Royale (Vienna)
description: Discover the bold elegance of Robusta Kaapi Royale Vienna Roast , an R19-certified Robusta masterpiece from the lush Magundi region of Karnataka. Sourced exclusively from Sethuraman Estate and masterfully produced by Nishant Gujer, this double-fermented, washed-processed gem is roasted to a rich Vienna level right here at Rossette Coffee Lab. Expect an explosion of indulgent flavours: creamy vanilla, warm spices, crunchy cocoa nibs, and toasted roasted almonds. Its full body and low acidity make it versatile for multiple brews like espresso, french press, south indian filter etc.

name: Basankhan Fermented Washed
description: Discover the rich, indulgent profile of Basankhan Estate Fermented Washed SLN 795 , a chocolatey, sweet, and citrus-forward washed coffee from the renowned Basankhan Estate in Karnataka's Chikmagalur region, profile roasted to a medium-dark profile by Rossette, perfect for espresso lovers craving depth and balance. This standout lot, crafted through a 48-hour fermented washed process, unlocks exceptional high sweetness, low acidity, and a heavy velvety body, with natural tasting notes of tangerine, prune, cane syrup, and cocoa that layer beautifully on the palate. Whether you're brewing it in a moka pot, espresso machine, French press, cold brew, or Aeropress, this versatile coffee shines brightest with milk—think creamy lattes or cappuccinos where its chocolatey sweetness takes centre stage for an elevated, everyday indulgence.

name: Hardoor Estate (Farm Organic) Washed
description: Discover the exceptional balance of Hardoor Estate Organic Coffee from the lush Coorg region of Karnataka, a truly special, farm-certified organic coffee that's been carefully roasted to a medium profile by Rosette Coffee Lab to highlight its natural harmony. Produced by Mukul using his innovative 16-hour dry fermented washed process, this lot develops its signature high sweetness, impressively low acidity, and smooth medium body, revealing beautiful tasting notes of raisin, grapes, brown sugar, and floral honey that dance sweetly across the palate. Whether you're enjoying it as a comforting milk-based drink like a latte or cappuccino, or savouring it black as a clean Americano, this versatile coffee from Coorg's renowned estate delivers an elevated experience perfect for specialty coffee lovers seeking quality, complexity, and everyday indulgence. Ideal for all brewing methods

name: Robusta Kaapi Royale
description: Elevate your cup with Robusta Kaapi Royale Medium Dark Roast , an R19-certified Robusta from the vibrant Magundi region of Karnataka. Harvested from Sethuraman Estate and expertly produced by Nishant Gujer, this double-fermented, washed-processed beauty is roasted to a balanced medium dark level at Rossette Coffee Lab. Unleash layers of caramel sweetness, cinnamon warmth, dark chocolate richness, juicy tropical fruits, and nutty undertones. With medium body, low acidity, and medium-high sweetness, it delivers smooth indulgence without harsh edges ideal for everyday sipping or lattes.

name: Harley Rum Aged (SCA 87+)
description: Speciality washed coffee from Harley estate has been aged with rum to enhance the inherent fruitiness and bring out the sweet flavours of rum & raisin. The resultant coffee develops a good body with notes of ripe blueberries with a citrus finish. This coffee has a long lasting finish which shall linger on your palate with a creamy texture.

name: Colombian Huila Decaf
description: Our first decaf , and it’s anything but boring. This coffee comes from San Agustín, Huila , grown at 1900 MASL, where the cool altitude brings depth and sweetness to every bean. It’s washed processed , then decaffeinated using the DCM method : a gentle extraction that keeps the flavour, loses the caffeine. Roasted medium-dark for espresso , this cup hits like a cozy dessert : Valencia Orange zest , roasted hazelnuts , and chocolate spread all rolled into one smooth finish. Perfect for your espresso machine, moka pot, AeroPress, or French press . All the taste. None of the jitters.

name: Wave
description: Crafted from a bold mix of Arabica and Robusta beans, this medium-dark roast offers a full-bodied experience with minimal acidity. Its rich, well-rounded profile makes it a perfect choice for those who enjoy a smooth yet intense cup. With notes of bittersweet chocolate, butter biscuits, and caramel, every sip delivers a deep, comforting flavour with a subtly sweet, biscuity finish. Whether brewed as an espresso or a strong black coffee, this blend provides a satisfying balance of depth and smoothness.

name: Midnight Blues
description: Crafted for those who love a bold yet balanced cup, this dark roast blend is made from 100% Arabica beans, expertly sourced from washed and naturally processed coffees. Roasted to a deep, rich profile—darker than a medium roast but not as intense as a Vienna roast—this blend offers a smooth and full-bodied experience with low acidity. Savor notes of cacao nibs, sweet spices, and toasted nuts, creating a comforting and well-rounded flavour. Whether brewed as an espresso or a classic drip coffee, this blend delivers a satisfying depth without overwhelming bitterness. Perfect for those who enjoy a refined yet robust dark roast.

name: Truffle Twilight
description: Our bestseller blend which combines two washed coffees one from Baarbara Estate and another one from Attikan Estate roasted to a medium- dark level to offer a fudgy chocolate like coffee with heavy body, minimal acidty and dried fruit overtones. This blend pairs extremely well with milk and is suitable for espresso , mokapot and French press brews.

name: Vienna Roast
description: For the people who like their coffee strong, here’s presenting our Vienna roast which is the darkest of our standard roasts meant for the people who want the strong kick in their morning cup. Pairs beautifully with milk and best suited to be brewed on a French Press, Mokapot , Espresso Machine or a South Indian Filter.
